contact.title: FAQ & Wholesale Support
contact.subtitle: Direct contact with your wholesale account manager and answers to frequently asked questions.
contact.sentSuccess: Thank you! Your message has been sent to our B2B team.
contact.faq1Q: What is the minimum order value (MOV)?
contact.faq1A: No, there is no minimum order value. You can order flexibly starting from 1 unit or any order amount.
contact.faq2Q: What are your delivery times and shipping partners?
contact.faq2A: Orders are dispatched swiftly from our central warehouse via DHL & UPS. Standard delivery takes 24-48 hours within Germany and 2-4 days across Europe.
contact.faq3Q: Can EU dealers outside Germany purchase tax-exempt?
contact.faq3A: Yes! All verified EU companies with an active VAT ID (USt-IdNr.) receive tax-exempt intra-community deliveries under the EU Reverse Charge mechanism (0% VAT).
contact.faq4Q: What payment methods are supported for wholesale accounts?
contact.faq4A: We offer Credit / Debit Card (Visa, Mastercard with 3D Secure), PayPal Express, Instant Banking (Sofort / Klarna), SEPA Direct Debit, Prepayment (Vorkasse), and Purchase on Invoice (14 days net) for approved dealers.
